title: [bundle] Fix the remaining hf focused-help navigation gap where hf <c
objective: Fix the remaining hf focused-help navigation gap where hf <command> --help still executes real command behavior or returns unknown for documented commands such as init seed index plan reconcile sync-cards export import migrate doctor gitignore schema session intake dispatch delivery promote gatekeeper hook. Help must be side-effect free, exit 0 for documented command topics, and print guidance for every documented top-level command while preserving fail-closed nonzero behavior for truly unknown commands/topics.
acceptance_criteria: hf <documented-command> --help and hf help <documented-command> are side-effect free and exit 0 for every documented top-level command topic.
Help invocations for mutating commands such as init, seed, index, plan, reconcile, sync-cards, schema, export, import, and migrate do not create or mutate repository files.
Truly unknown commands and unknown help topics still fail closed with a nonzero exit code.
Regression tests cover the all-documented-topic help contract and at least one no-side-effect mutating-help case.
